title: Trend Micro Apex One modOSCE SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Trend Micro Apex One. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the client management functionality. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of IUSR.
